# Cadrelia 0.1.1
Fixes from the first days of testing.
- Animated GIFs now play on the desktop, like videos (a "GIF" badge marks them). - Interactive hic et nunc works show their own cover image instead of a black disc. - Changing the framing of the artwork on screen no longer swaps it for another one. - The menu bar has a **Restart** button to start a live artwork again from the beginning, and says why an artwork set to move stays still (turned, on battery, Low Power Mode…). - The framing shown in an artwork's details is now the one actually used on the desktop. - The site moved to cadrelia.camilleroux.com.
Something wrong or confusing? **Send Feedback…** in the menu bar.

# Cadrelia 0.1.0: first test version
Thanks for trying Cadrelia! This is an early test version: things may change or break.
- Add Ethereum, Tezos or Bitcoin wallets and see your collection in the Library. - Hang your artworks on the desktop, live or as still images, with Fit, Fill or Mat framing. - Screen saver, labels, and exhibitions, frames and label styles for collectors.
Something wrong or confusing? **Send Feedback…** in the menu bar.
